exposure: Maternal urinary organophosphate ester (OPE) metabolites (individually and as a mixture)
outcome: Placental transcriptome at birth (co-expressed gene modules)
cohort: The study included 737 mother-infant dyads from the Conditions Affecting Neurocognitive Development and Learning in Early Childhood (CANDLE) study.
finding: Novel associations were identified between the placental transcriptome and OPE metabolites, individually and in mixtures, including differences based on fetal sex.
